verdict.rationale: Yapily documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents (Claude, Cursor, etc.) connect directly to its docs for a live, searchable connection, and a probe confirms the resource exists at docs.yapily.com/resources/ai-agents. This is docs-focused rather than exposing full banking API operations via MCP tools, so it's a real but limited agentic integration. Missing for 10: evidence of MCP tools invoking actual Yapily API operations (payments/data) rather than just documentation search, and independent/hands-on confirmation beyond the vendor's own docs and probe.
